headline: Lead DevOps Engineer | Multi-Cloud
page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead DevOps Engineer
summary_html: Lead DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cloud platforms, CI/CD automation, and production release delivery, with a focus on Azure engineering. Partners with development, QA, and data engineering teams to automate application and database releases. Combines Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Liquibase, Snowflake, Terraform, PowerShell, Python, and Bash with Azure infrastructure, container delivery, secure access, and operational troubleshooting. Builds version-controlled deployment processes with review gates, environment configuration, verification, and recovery planning.

achievements.text: Integrated version-controlled database changes with application releases, validation gates, deployment evidence, and recovery procedures.
Standardized reusable workflows, pull request checks, branching practices, and controlled promotion across development, QA, and production.
Connected Azure provisioning, cloud data-platform delivery, and operational monitoring to improve release consistency and developer productivity.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
impact: Owned CI/CD delivery for SaaS application and database releases, coordinating development, QA, and data engineering requirements, dependencies, release windows, and production verification.
Built reusable GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps workflows for application builds and Liquibase deployments, using pull request checks, environment approvals, and versioned release artifacts.
Managed Liquibase changelogs and ordered changesets in Git, validating syntax and reviewing generated SQL before promoting schema changes through development, QA, and production.
Automated Snowflake SQL deployments for databases, schemas, tables, views, and grants, separating environment configuration from version-controlled migration logic.
Configured Snowflake roles and warehouse settings, using least-privilege deployment access, auto-suspend, resource monitors, and query history to support secure and efficient operations.
Established GitHub repository conventions, branch protections, required reviews, and merge controls so application and database changes remained traceable to approved pull requests.
Developed Python, Bash, and PowerShell automation for pre-deployment checks, database connectivity validation, deployment summaries, and post-release smoke tests.
Provisioned Azure virtual networks, compute, and AKS infrastructure with Terraform; integrated Key Vault and federated pipeline authentication and published Docker images to Azure Container Registry.
Troubleshot failed migrations, Snowflake permissions, and pipeline failures using deployment logs and Azure Monitor; coordinated recovery with application owners and preserved release evidence.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Partnered with developers and QA on Azure-hosted application delivery, standardizing build-agent configuration, reusable pipeline stages, environment settings, and release checks.
Managed Liquibase changelogs in Git and automated Snowflake schema deployments through reviewed pipeline stages, separating development, QA, and production configuration.
Migrated Jenkins pipelines to GitLab CI and supported GitHub integration patterns for source review, automated validation, and release traceability.
Troubleshot Liquibase validation errors, Snowflake role permissions, and SQL deployment failures alongside Docker, Kubernetes, and runner issues with engineering teams.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer II
impact: Built GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines for application and database releases, coordinating schema updates with service rollout and post-deployment validation.
Integrated Liquibase validation and update stages for Snowflake schema changes, maintaining migration history, explicit rollback scripts, and reviewed environment promotion.
Provisioned Azure infrastructure through Terraform and ARM templates and deployed containerized services to AKS with Helm and ArgoCD.
Automated release checks and operational tasks using Python, Bash, and PowerShell; published versioned artifacts for repeatable downstream deployment.
Used Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and pipeline telemetry to investigate slow deployments, infrastructure failures, and application connectivity issues with development teams.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior SRE
impact: Delivered CI/CD automation for SaaS services and payment-platform workloads, aligning application releases, database dependencies, and infrastructure changes.
Standardized GitHub Actions and Jenkins workflows for build, test, artifact publication, and environment promotion, integrating SonarQube and secure secrets handling.
Developed Python FastAPI integrations for Jenkins, Jira, and JFrog to automate onboarding and reduce manual coordination of release activities.
Partnered with developers and data engineers on Liquibase changesets for Snowflake tables and views, reviewing SQL, application compatibility, deployment order, and recovery plans.
Administered CloudBees Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, and Xray, maintaining reusable shared libraries and consistent artifact versioning.
Built Terraform modules for Azure networking and AKS, standardized Helm deployments and Ansible configuration, and used Prometheus and Grafana to support incident diagnosis.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Built Jenkins and Maven delivery pipelines for REST microservices across test, security-validation, UAT, and production environments.
Coordinated Liquibase database changes and Snowflake SQL deployments with developers and QA, documenting migration order, role requirements, environment configuration, and verification steps.
Automated Azure virtual machines, virtual networks, and Linux configuration with ARM templates, Ansible, and PowerShell; managed Key Vault integration and secure database connectivity.
Packaged Kubernetes services with Helm and used ELK, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics to troubleshoot deployment and application failures.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
impact: Created repeatable build and deployment pipelines for API, database, and UI components, promoting consistent artifacts across development and production.
Maintained Git branching practices and Liquibase changelogs for Snowflake schema changes, versioning SQL and environment configuration to improve release traceability.
Automated Azure infrastructure with Terraform and ARM templates and application deployments with Ansible, Python, and PowerShell, keeping configuration consistent across environments.
Managed build agents, release parameters, and deployment documentation, troubleshooting failed releases with development and operations teams.
